meta.title: 작전명 비단
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (작전명 비단, a six-part spy drama set in Seoul in 1966 (fictional series)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 작전명 비단, a six-part spy drama set in Seoul in 1966 (fictional series)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A 1960s title sequence in flat cut paper: orange #E2702A, teal #1E6C74, cream #EEE4CF, ink #151311 and mustard #E2B13A as fields and shapes, and one red #C81E2C kept for the silk ribbon, the hat band, the eye and the stamp.
rationale.type: Black Han Sans, heavy and condensed like cut letters, dropped in one by one for the title and the names; Gothic A1 Bold for roles and small lines.
rationale.motion: Title-sequence grammar: diagonal bars sweep in on the beat, shapes slide and snap into place, match cuts keep one centre while the shape changes (a spotlight, an eye, the moon), panels open as strips, and one stop-time where everything freezes with the music before a stamp lands.
rationale.sound: Swing at 128 BPM in D minor as a spy band on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): vibraphone comping, a pizzicato walking bass, a trumpet hook, tenor saxophone and trumpet stabs in key on the hits, ride and brushes; a hush cue cuts the band to silence for the freeze.
rationale.visuals: All code: every shape is a polygon with subdivided, nudged edges and a thin offset shadow, like paper cut with scissors and stacked; an agent figure on a walk cycle, an almond eye, a skyline of tiled roofs and blocks, a ribbon swept along a curve with a twisting width.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the band carries it.
